summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group (Nasdaq: LHSW) filed a Form 6-K with two press releases, the lead item being a 1-for-8 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective at the October 26, 2026 Nasdaq open under new CUSIP G5480C120, with par value rising from US$0.0016 to US$0.0128. Shares outstanding drop from 22,878,354 Class A and 2,587,500 Class B to roughly 2,859,795 and 323,438. The stated objective is maintaining the Nasdaq Capital Market listing; shareholders approved May 28, 2026 and the board on October 6, 2026. Watch for a possible reverse-split-driven minimum-bid cure and subsequent dilution risk.
